Your trip, in brief
Lisbon

A trip to Lisbon for 2 travelers. Your interests: Food and culture. Priorities: A quiet base and an unhurried pace.

Getting around by metro. The visitor site calls the metro the easiest way to get around. It runs daily 6:30 a.m. to 1:00 a.m., the last departure from each line's terminal stations. Check fares and rules before travel. Check metro tickets and hours ↗
(opens in a new tab)

Metro tickets and cards. Metro payment options include a navegante occasional card, a personalized card, or a contactless bank card. The occasional card can't be shared between passengers, so two travelers need separate cards or payments. Check metro tickets and hours ↗
(opens in a new tab)

Food and wine ideas. The official visitor site has an Eat & Drink category and presents wine culture as a distinct attraction under Lisbon Flavours. It's a starting point for food-focused plans. Explore areas, food and Lisboa Card ↗
